name: Corrupted Rager
body:
Barbarians who have been trapped in a hostile magical environment—the nascent energies of the plane have inexorably changed them, and fuel their strength.

The corrupted rager is an archetype of the barbarian class.

Malefic Rage (Su)

A corrupted rager is bound by the plane which they’re tied to, and can call upon its powers even when they’re outside of that plane. This is how they receive powers from their rage, no longer merely relying on their natural bloodlust but instead fracturing their mind, body, and soul with the planar energy. Once chosen this choice cannot be changed later. Choose one plane from the list below:

Name	Ability Scores
Abyss	Strength and Constitution
Hell	Dexterity and Charisma
Abaddon	Strength and Constitution
Limbo	Strength and Charisma
Negative Energy Plane	Constitution and Wisdom
Shadow Plane	Dexterity and Charisma

Bonds with different planes grant different bonuses while raging, with some even granting bonuses to mental ability scores. All other benefits and penalties from raging are retained, this only changes where the bonuses are applied. In addition, the bonuses are changed from morale bonuses to instead profane bonuses.

This alters rage, greater rage, and mighty rage.

Evasion (Ex)

At 2nd level, a corrupted rager can avoid even magical and unusual attacks with great agility. If he makes a successful Reflex saving throw against an attack that normally deals half damage on a successful save, he instead takes no damage. Evasion can be used only if the corrupted rager is wearing light, medium, no armor. A helpless corrupted rager does not gain the benefit of evasion.

This replaces uncanny dodge, and the corrupted rager does not gain uncanny dodge until 5th level.

Powers from Beyond (Su)

At 2nd level, and every 4 levels thereafter the corrupted rager receives boons gifted from the plane they chose to align themselves with. They receive the bloodline powers from a corresponding bloodrager bloodline, except they receive them later—they receive the 1st level bloodline power at 2nd level, and then receive the bloodline power 2 levels later than normal. They thus do not receive the 20th level ability, receiving the 16th level bloodline power at 18th level.

Your bloodline powers use Constitution in place of Charisma unless the corrupted rager’s Malefic Rage grants a bonus to a mental ability score, in which it’ll use that mental ability score instead.

Plane Name	Bloodline
Abyss	Abyssal
Hell	Infernal
Abaddon	Black Blood
Limbo	Aberrant
Negative Energy Plane	Undead
Shadow Plane	Kyton

This replaces rage powers gained at 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th.
